summary: Removed US-005, its decomposition cluster, and AC-22/AC-23 while preserving the installed V1/V2 procedure as a separate lead-owned gate after the source Ralph job terminates.

Separated candidate-based toolkit source work from lead-owned codexu evidence work, added absolute repository and ancestry preflights, and replaced the infeasible parallel handoff with a serial target-repo workflow.
Expanded the deferred installed gate with exact forced-surface commands, provenance and command records, surface assertions, immutable run evidence, and pre/post SHA-256 preservation checks.

Reordered the lead-owned release flow to integrate and publish the reviewed candidate, verify SHAs, refresh installed copies, run installed V1/V2 acceptance, then tag and complete codexu pointer/version-table closeout.
Added a lead-owned reconciliation and revalidation prerequisite before publishing the divergent 4100a48d candidate.
Added a structured per-site and role output contract matrix requirement with exhaustive tests and explicit artifact schema, freshness, run attribution, hash, and owning-child provenance criteria.
Specified per-lens V1 fan-out markers and narrowed byte-preservation assertions to the unchanged task body following the intentional marker prefix.
Mapped every affected generated dispatch phase and prohibited plan fallback clause to static assertions, with injected child-failure coverage where available.
Re-review round 1 found 2 new Medium+ finding(s)
Updated strategy step 7 to hash every pre-existing dogfood evidence and runner file, including older run directories, while excluding only the newly created run directory.
Moved prerequisite-blocked installed-gate obligations out of source-job acceptance criteria into an explicitly excluded post-source lead-owned gate.
Re-review round 2 found 1 new Medium+ finding(s)
Separated generated-runtime identity binding from telemetry-only child agent_path verification in the acceptance criteria and US-001/US-002 scopes.
Reordered Stage B so all pre-existing dogfood files are baselined before a corrected runner is copied only into the new run directory and executed, with post-run integrity verification.
Copilot-secondary re-review failed after retry exhaustion.
